reasons: Fuel surcharge amount higher than contract rate for the pickup week
Invoice total $80.43 above contract total, >1% variance
decision.dispute_summary: Fuel surcharge applied at 24.96% of DOE price but amount billed ($114.55) exceeds the contract‑computed fuel surcharge ($98.45). Total invoice ($573.50) is $80.43 above the contract‑supported amount ($493.07), exceeding the 1% tolerance.
